title: The Lord's Prayer
summary: The Lord's Prayer follows a real Bible moment about prayer. Jesus teaches us to pray with trust, worship, daily dependence, forgiveness, and help. When prayer feels confusing, the Lord's Prayer gives kids a simple shape: worship, needs, forgiveness, and help.

read_it.prompt: Read Matthew 6:5-13 slowly and listen for the choice, promise, warning, or rescue in the story.

tell_it: Jesus taught His followers to pray to the Father. Jesus taught His followers how to pray. The prayer begins with honoring the Father and asks for daily needs and forgiveness. The pressure in the scene helps the lesson feel real.
understand_it: Jesus teaches us to pray with trust, worship, daily dependence, forgiveness, and help. The Lord's Prayer also shows that prayer has a shape in real life, not only in Bible vocabulary.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus taught His followers to pray to the Father.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus taught His followers how to pray. The prayer begins with honoring the Father and asks for daily needs and forgiveness. Kids can practice retelling it with the beginning, hard moment, and God-centered ending.
teen_explanation: Jesus teaches us to pray with trust, worship, daily dependence, forgiveness, and help. A teen discussion can press into why the story mattered then and how the same truth can reshape choices now.
key_truths: Jesus teaches us to pray with trust, worship, daily dependence, forgiveness, and help.
The Lord's Prayer shows prayer through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When prayer feels confusing, the Lord's Prayer gives kids a simple shape: worship, needs, forgiveness, and help.
life_application: When prayer feels confusing, the Lord's Prayer gives kids a simple shape: worship, needs, forgiveness, and help.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer keeps The Lord's Prayer connected to the actual passage?
choices: Jesus said not to pray at all
The prayer is only for priests
Prayer is only asking for things
quiz_questions.explanation: Jesus is the story detail to remember. The bigger lesson grows out of that detail instead of floating away from the passage.

quiz_questions.question: The Lord's Prayer is mainly about prayer without ignoring the actual Bible story.
quiz_questions.explanation: The theme matters because it grows out of Matthew 6:5-13, not from a random moral pasted onto the end.

memory_verse.prompt: Practice Matthew 6:9 and listen for how it supports the lesson's prayer theme.

discussion_questions: Who needed help, courage, correction, or mercy in The Lord's Prayer?
What truth should a kid remember after reading The Lord's Prayer?
How can the group pray about The Lord's Prayer without using pretend-perfect answers?

activity.title: Prayer Pattern Hands
activity.instructions: Trace a hand and label each finger with one part of the prayer Jesus taught.

prayer_prompt: Lord, use The Lord's Prayer to teach my heart, not just my memory. Help me take one faithful next step after reading The Lord's Prayer.
